statement: To register a company, a person must lodge an application with ASIC; the application must state the type of company proposed, the proposed name (unless the ACN is to be used in the name), the name and address of each consenting member, the personal details and address of each consenting director and company secretary, the proposed registered office address, the shares each member agrees in writing to take up for a company limited by shares, and the State or Territory in which the company is to be taken to be registered.
caveat: Section 117(2) carries further items (public-company office hours, non-cash consideration particulars, ultimate holding company details), and directors must hold director identification numbers before appointment (section 1272C). Most registrations are lodged online through ASIC or the Business Registration Service; check the current form before filing.
